1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/frame.rs:87` and `:134`: add named `frame_cost::span` scopes for the new header and footer. Class: new UI sections without named cost measurements. The current `ui/windows` scope combines all windows. It does not name these new sections. Upstream `crates/ui/AGENTS.md`, under Frame cost, requires a named span for each new frame piece. Apply the rule to both sections, so the probe can report each cost.
2. Commit messages (`1b180b750`, `67ed5a864`, `06f05c1b5`, `b1365b233`): each uses `Refs #4334`. No fixing commit contains `Fixes #4334`. Class: missing issue closure metadata on the fixing commit. Upstream `AGENTS.md:357` and `:863` require this footer. The PR targets main and says that it completes #4334. Put `Fixes #4334` in the final corrective commit. Keep the existing history; do not rewrite or force-push it.
